description: Assembly source code implementing multiple big number (bignum) arithmetic functions for BoringSSL's FIPS module, including multiplication, squaring, division, addition, and subtraction of large integers, with optimized paths for SSE2 and non-SSE2 environments.

methods.name: bn_mul_add_words
methods.description: Performs multiplication and addition on large numbers with optimized SSE2 and non-SSE2 paths.

methods.name: bn_mul_words
methods.description: Performs multiplication of large numbers with optimized SSE2 and non-SSE2 paths.

methods.name: bn_sqr_words
methods.description: Squares large numbers with optimized SSE2 and non-SSE2 paths.

methods.name: bn_div_words
methods.description: Divides large numbers, simple division operation.

methods.name: bn_add_words
methods.description: Adds large numbers with carry handling.

methods.name: bn_sub_words
methods.description: Subtracts large numbers with borrow handling.
